name: carbon
description: CARBON includes Jay, the world's first AI test manager agent. CARBON Light — AI testing inside your coding agent. Testing workflows, all recorded findings and current-run reports. Internal business use permitted under PolyForm Perimeter. Default tests use your coding agent's configured model access: an eligible subscription or API billing, with no separate CARBON model key. Local runs store evidence and reports in your workspace; context sent to the host's model provider is not local-only.
